headline: Limited access, and agents that keep going
lede: Gemini 4 Argon is still limited to trusted defenders. Sonnet 5.5 is out for scoped work, Claude Code aliases on the Anthropic API now resolve to 5.5, ChatGPT dots keep working between chats, and Work IQ business data is in preview.
summary: Gemini 4 Argon stays with a set of trusted defenders. Claude Sonnet 5.5 is the scoped-work model, and on the Anthropic API the Claude Code aliases opus and sonnet now resolve to 5.5. ChatGPT dots keep working between chats for eligible paid plans. Work IQ's business-data preview has started.
page_title: This Week in AI, Oct 4, 2026: Argon stays limited
meta_description: Reviewed Oct 4, 2026: Argon stays limited, Sonnet 5.5 is out, Claude Code aliases move to 5.5, ChatGPT dots keep going, and Work IQ business data is in preview.
prompt_of_week: You are handing off one recurring workflow. Goal: [ONE OUTCOME]. Inputs you may read: [NAMED FILES OR SYSTEMS]. Tools you may use: [LIST]. You may not send, pay, delete, or change access. Stop and ask when a source is missing, a figure is not in the inputs, or the next step needs a human sign-off. Return the draft, the sources you used, and anything you refused to do.

updates.title: Gemini 4 Argon is limited access
updates.body: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on 30 September 2026 and is rolling it out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program, not as a general release. Broader access starts later with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers.
updates.action: Write down one complex workflow you would hand off, and the human check that still has to pass.

updates.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is for scoped work
updates.body: Anthropic released Sonnet 5.5 on 28 September 2026 as a faster, lower-cost complement to Opus 5.5 for well-scoped tasks such as bugs, documents, slides, and spreadsheets. In Claude Code and Anthropic's apps, the default effort is Medium.
updates.action: Move one well-scoped task you already own onto Sonnet 5.5 before you spend Opus on it.

updates.title: Claude Code aliases now point at 5.5
updates.body: On the Anthropic API, opus resolves to Opus 5.5 and sonnet resolves to Sonnet 5.5. Claude Platform on AWS still resolves sonnet to Sonnet 4.6. Bedrock and Google Cloud Agent Platform resolve it to Sonnet 4.5. Microsoft Foundry resolves opus to Opus 4.6 and sonnet to Sonnet 4.5. Sonnet 5.5 needs Claude Code v2.1.284 or later, and Opus 5.5 needs v2.1.280 or later.
updates.action: Check which alias your session resolves. If a 5.5 request fails, update Claude Code before you brief a long task.

updates.title: ChatGPT dots keep working between chats
updates.body: OpenAI describes dots as always-on agents in ChatGPT that take ongoing work and keep going between conversations. You set a goal, connect the apps, and define what the dot may do on its own. Rollout is gradual for eligible Pro and Business Premium users aged 18 or older. Pro excludes the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK at launch, and Enterprise is a beta that is off by default.
updates.action: Write the brief before you create one: goal, inputs, allowed tools, and the stop condition.

updates.title: Work IQ business data is in preview
updates.body: Microsoft's 25 September 2026 post says Work IQ now grounds Copilot and agents in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform data, plus Microsoft 365 context. The preview started 30 September 2026 and continues through October. Governed actions stay inside the user's permissions and can require approval.
updates.action: Name one business question that needs your Dynamics or Power Platform data, then decide whether Work IQ should be on for that question.
